हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Raised by Master David and gifted with unmatched martial skills, Julie sets out to defend her fallen homeland, Daxia, from foreign invaders and deep-rooted betrayal. With her past cloaked in tragedy and her future carved in vengeance, she’s not just a fighter—she’s the legend her enemies fear. There’s None Under Heaven Equal to Her is a tale of legacy, loyalty, and one woman’s unstoppable rise. Watch Now!
